channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 15A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 15A (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15A: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can…
item.description: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can change and belongs in the record's status, not in a permanent name or page address. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: No source change; the status is shown in the record's status field..

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15A: Block 15A's notes said the block is surface parking…
item.description: Block 15A's notes said the block is surface parking (satellite-confirmed) and designated for UCSF institutional use, citing only the 2019 land use map, which shows neither. They now say the parking is our own observation in USDA NAIP imagery and cite UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck (undeveloped, Block 15 – Housing), and the use is corrected from institutional to residential. The 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map for the undivided block and drops two unverifiable clauses. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).
item.source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 15A: UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation… (Jun 12, 2025)
item.description: UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation (meeting date) lists 'Block 15 – Housing' on its slide of 'Undeveloped parcels remaining, and uses per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan'; an earlier slide of the same deck says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now' (Jun 12, 2025). Source: UCSF, posted by the Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2025-06-12.
item.source: UCSF, posted by the Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2025-06-12

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15A: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019)… (Dec 2019)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019) shows this lettered block (15A) in the 'UCSF' color; the Successor Agency's Dec 2015 property map (Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B, page 12) shows block 15 as a single undivided grey block without UCSF color-coding (Dec 2019). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 15A: UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File… (~Sep 2016)
item.description: UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary contractor parking on Blocks 15 and 16 (recounted in Addendum #4); a separate September 26, 2016 notice covers wet-utility piping and surface work 'in and adjacent to' Blocks 14, 15, 16 and 18 (~Sep 2016). Source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-04-28; Regents of the University of California, via CEQAnet, 2016-09-26.
item.source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-04-28; Regents of the University of California, via CEQAnet, 2016-09-26

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15A: UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range… (Nov 2014)
item.description: UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range Development Plan Environmental Impact Report (November 20, 2014) and approve the plan; the report analysed new housing and a relocated child care facility on Block 15 (as recounted in the 2017 addenda). UCSF's documents name the block 'Block 15' without an A/B split (Nov 2014). Source: UCSF Campus Planning / UC Regents, 2017-02-27.
